notes: Company background: Inkwell builds a VS Code-first copilot tailored for enterprise engineering teams. Focus on low-latency inline suggestions and session continuity across devices.
Primary ask: sub-50ms tail latency for single-line suggestions; streaming completions should start rendering within 30-50ms of token emission for a smooth UX.
Model/versioning: want ability to pin model per-customer and to do safe rollouts (canary + rollback). Also need deterministic token usage estimates for pricing.
Auth & rate limits: extension will authenticate users via org SSO + short-lived tokens. Need per-org and per-user rate limits + graceful 429 handling in-editor.
Caching/batching: interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for prefix/KV caching to reduce cost for repeated code patterns and project templates.
Quote from CTO (Alex R.): 'If we can't get consistent inline latency across our beta customers, adoption will stall — latency is the UX.'
Integration notes: extension currently uses a proxy service to multiplex WebSocket connections from VS Code; want to evaluate using Redwood streaming edges directly to reduce hops.
Data residency: many enterprise customers want logs retained in-region (US/EU). Inkwell wants Redwood to demonstrate residency controls in the POC.
POC success criteria: 1) median inline suggestion latency <20ms, 95th <60ms; 2) streaming start <50ms; 3) functional SSO + seat admin; 4) cost estimate for 100k monthly active devs.
Admin comments: procurement asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; security team to review Redwood security FAQ (linked).
